content.title: Housing Advisory Committee
content.summary: The Housing Advisory Committee was established on November 7, 2022, with its first members appointed on April 17, 2023. The committee consists of nine volunteer members and meets monthly from 6:00 to 7:30 p.m. at City Hall, with a Zoom option available. Recruitment for new members will begin in December, and interested individuals can find the application process on the city's Boards, Commissions, and Committees page.
content.body:
## Overview

The Housing Advisory Committee was created November 7, 2022, and its first members were appointed April 17, 2023.

## Meeting Information

- 6:00 to 7:30 p.m.
- City Council Room (CCR)  
  City Hall  
  8101 Ralston Road
- [Zoom Link for meetings](https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84244271343?pwd=Y3lKZlNrTTVzZE15M1doSEllM3hsdz09)

## Board Details

- 9 members
- As a new board term length with vary
- Volunteer appointment

## Interested in Joining the Housing Advisory Committee?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
